facial_anchors.face_shape: Small delicate oval face, soft pointed chin, refined jawline, petite and elegant
facial_anchors.eyes: Large bright almond eyes, clear defined double eyelids, long natural lashes, warm gentle gaze — NOT colored contacts, natural dark brown iris
facial_anchors.eyebrows: Soft feathered natural eyebrows, gentle arch, not too thick
facial_anchors.nose: Small straight nose, delicate refined bridge, do NOT emphasize or redden nose
facial_anchors.lips: Soft full lips, natural pink tint, gentle closed-mouth smile or neutral expression
facial_anchors.hair: Jet black straight hair with perfectly straight-cut bangs across forehead, silky smooth texture, long flowing past shoulders
facial_anchors.skin: Flawless luminous fair skin, glass skin texture, natural healthy glow — NOT airbrushed, subtle pores visible
facial_anchors.overall_vibe: Chinese beauty idol standard (小红书审美): delicate, ethereal, pure, gentle, refined — like a top-tier wuxia actress

face_consistency_prompt: Jet black straight hair with straight-cut bangs, large bright almond eyes with clear double eyelids, small straight nose, soft pink lips, small oval face, fair luminous skin, gentle warm expression. Chinese beauty idol standard. KEEP FACE EXACTLY THE SAME.
